messages:
tom_sales: FYI StratusHealth wants a 3-week POC to validate SSO (Okta) + SCIM + strict tenant email/domain locking. also group->role mapping and 1yr audit retention for HIPAA. can we confirm scope and pricing?

mira_se: TL;DR: SAML supported (IdP & SP flows), SCIM v2 with PATCH (delta) supported, group->role mapping available in Console. domain proofing via TXT + tenant-claim checks prevents cross-tenant email claims.

stratus_contact: security requires encrypted assertions, session idle timeout 10m, and customer-managed KMS for keys. they also want rate guidance for SCIM spikes (migration up to 7k/day).

sam_infosec: noted: we support signed + encrypted assertions. exchange SP metadata and IdP certs. cert rotation default 90d; can document alternate cadence. audit trail captures SCIM provisioning events + admin actions; enterprise add-on extends retention to 1yr.

lena_ops: pricing snapshot: Hosted POC recommended for fast run (est $1-1.5k/week depending on tokens) unless BAA/HSM needed. Dedicated trial (3w) needs small reserved commit (~$3.5k one-time) for predictable latency and higher SCIM bursts. Private: custom for on-prem and HSM. Hosted audit logs default 90d; 1yr add-on available.

mira_se: SCIM throughput guidance: Hosted default 600 reqs/min, Dedicated burst to 1200. use PATCH for deltas to minimize payload and error rates. sample PATCH we give to customers:
```
PATCH /Users/9a7c
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "path": "emails[type eq \"work\"].value", "value": "anna@stratushealth.com" }]
}
```

k8s-bot: infra ticket INF-5123 created  reserve Dedicated test node (1x A10g equiv) for stratus-poc, window 3 weeks. assigned: eng-runtime.

sam_infosec: questions for Stratus: 1) confirm NameID format (email vs persistent) 2) provide SP metadata URL 3) supply IP allowlist for SSO endpoints 4) confirm whether provisioning audit entries must be exported to customer SIEM.

stratus_contact: NameID = persistent preferred. will send SP metadata, Okta group CSV, and allowlist today. yes, SIEM export required (syslog or S3 delivery).

lena_ops: action items: 1) Stratus -> SP metadata + Okta CSV + allowlist + expected daily token volume; 2) Mira -> SCIM config + RBAC mapping example + canary rollout snippet; 3) Sam -> SOC2/HIPAA artifact links + cert exchange steps; 4) Infra -> confirm INF-5123 timing. I'll prepare a short POC estimate (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and a BAA note.

tom_sales: i'll bundle SOW: week1 domain proof + SAML smoke, week2 SCIM + RBAC mapping, week3 migration spike test + signoff. aiming to send to Stratus legal by EOD. :thumbsup:
